title: Tide and Harbor
author: Sable Sandoval
blurb: Silas Dunmore, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
